messages.content: Record: Name=Sam; favorite color=blue; age=20. Return only the favorite color.

rubric: Return the stated color with no unrelated fields.

messages.content: Summarize in one sentence: The team moved Friday's meeting to Monday at 10 a.m. because two members were traveling. The room stays the same.

rubric: Mention the new Monday 10 a.m. time and preserve the unchanged room; avoid invented details.

messages.content: Write a polite two-sentence reminder asking a classmate to return my library book tomorrow.

rubric: Exactly two polite sentences requesting return of the library book tomorrow.

messages.content: Write a Python function add(a, b) that returns their sum. Show only the function.

rubric: A valid function named add with parameters a and b returning a + b. Inspect as text; never execute generated code.

messages.content: A bag has 3 red and 2 blue marbles. One marble is drawn uniformly. What is the probability it is blue? Give a fraction.

rubric: The probability is 2/5; no replacement or second draw is involved.

messages.content: What did I name my project? Reply only with the name.

rubric: Use the earlier conversation and return Arbiter.
